./configure \
  --prefix=<DIST_DIR> \
  --arch=x86_64 \
  --target-os=mingw32 \
  --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32- \
  --disable-static \
  --enable-shared \
  --disable-programs \
  --disable-doc \
  --disable-everything \
  --enable-decoder=hevc \
  --enable-parser=hevc \
  --enable-protocol=file \
  --disable-gpl \
  --disable-nonfree \
  --disable-version3 \
  --disable-autodetect \
  --disable-network \
  --disable-debug \
  --enable-stripping
